admin_realtime_order_alerts.visual: Flashing Red/Amber banner + Animated Bell Icon in Top Header when a new 'PENDING' order arrives.
admin_realtime_order_alerts.audio: Web Audio Synthesizer or chime sound effect on order event.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure: Use standard React JavaScript files (.js / .jsx). Do NOT write .tsx code.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_ids: CRITICAL: MUST include `data-testid` on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, badges, tab items, cart controls, and admin order action buttons.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons_library: Use `lucide-react` icons (ShoppingBag, Truck, MapPin, Award, ShieldCheck, Flame, Bell, Phone, CheckCircle, Search, Plus, Minus, Trash2).
instructions_to_main_agent.toast_notifications: Use `sonner` via `toast.success()`, `toast.error()`, `toast.info()` for cart updates, login states, and QRIS payments.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never produce generic centered text layouts or plain white Vercel templates.
Always wrap currency in Indonesian format: `new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID', { style: 'currency', currency: 'IDR', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(price)` -> Rp 15.000.
Containers with borders MUST have explicit internal padding (`p-4`, `p-6`) to avoid edge text collision.
Provide micro-animations on hover (`hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-200 shadow-md`).
All navigation bars must remain visible and legible with standard backdrop blur and solid or semi-solid glass layer.
